description: Election Commission - Seyyadu Ahamed Mohamad Rimsad elected as the member of the Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: This gazette concerns filling a vacancy in a local government body (Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls under election-related administrative matters.
